name: Tools for Steelgrill
summary: At Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone sends you northeast with tools for Beldin Steelgrill at the depot. The road leads from town to the mechanics and war machines gathered there.

sections.title: A Master Rough on His Gear
sections.body: Across Dun Morogh, Beldin Steelgrill is known as the sharpest siege engine mechanic in the mountains. His rough work breaks arclight spanners and other tools faster than Kharanos suppliers can replace them. Tharek Blackstone has a fresh batch of durable gear ready, so a traveler bound northeast carries the heavy crate to the depot.

sections.title: Keeping the Engines Running
sections.body: Steelgrill's Depot is crowded with idle war machines and military repairs. Beldin's backlog includes urgent work on Pilot Stonegear's siege engine. He broke his last fang-ratchet only hours before you arrive. The crate is needed to keep Ironforge's tracked armor fleet running.

faq.q: Where do I take the tools?
faq.answer: Take the tools northeast from Kharanos along the road toward Ironforge. Beldin Steelgrill works at Steelgrill's Depot among parked siege engines and tanks.

Beldin Steelgrill is a renowned dwarven mechanic who specializes in siege engines and runs Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. He oversees repairs, modifications, and maintenance for veteran pilots serving Ironforge's armored forces.

faq.q: Why does Beldin break so many tools?
faq.answer: Siege engines are massive war machines with heavy plating and oversized iron fittings. Their reinforced hulls demand leverage and force, often snapping arclight spanners and fang-ratchets during urgent repairs.

faq.q: Whose siege engine is Beldin fixing?
faq.answer: Beldin is repairing the siege engine belonging to Pilot Stonegear, a veteran dwarven pilot stationed at the depot.
Steelgrill's Depot is an open-air workshop and staging ground northeast of Kharanos. Veteran siege engine pilots and tank crews gather there to test, tune, and repair their armored treads.

faq.q: Why does Tharek Blackstone ask an adventurer to carry them?
faq.answer: Tharek Blackstone has filled Steelgrill's latest tool order and needs a traveler heading northeast to carry the heavy crate. He offers modest coin and an introduction to the veteran pilots up the road.

angles.text: Beldin relies on precision tools such as arclight spanners and fang-ratchets. Their strain shows how mechanical warfare taxes crafted instruments.
As a dwarf, you know Ironforge's armored forces rely on field repair stations like Steelgrill's Depot to keep siege engines moving across the frozen passes.
As a gnome, you recognize the arclight spanners and intricate ratchets Beldin uses as precision instruments shaped by gnomish engineering and adapted for dwarven plate.
